final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS group_avg_alb, AVG(l.UN * 1.0 / NULLIF(l."T-BIL", 0)) AS group_avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(group_avg_alb) AS A, AVG(group_avg_ratio) AS avg_group_ratio FROM patient_groups GROUP BY SEX), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.A, s.avg_group_ratio, s.A - o.B AS "A - B" FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.B IS NOT NULL AND s.A > o.B
